scope: Linux GTK and Windows Win32/WebView2 native-widget feasibility fixtures; actual host receipts retain their tested source. Full application/backend/input/release remains unfinished.

requirements.finalGui: Native Rust application widgets; Monaco and xterm remain embedded offline JavaScript components. A whole Tauri HTML application shell does not fulfill this requirement.
requirements.finalBackend: All application state, orchestration and authority in Rust; no Python GUI, application server or hidden Python backend service in the replacement.
requirements.pythonRuntime: Only approved external firmware-tool dependencies in the replacement; development reference/controller verifiers may use Python.
requirements.nativeDependencies: Rust-authored application code may use GTK/Win32 and system WebKit/WebView2 libraries; this does not claim every dependency is implemented in Rust.
requirements.tauriRole: Retain the tested web-shell fixture and reusable core/host/contracts while the native widget adapters and full backend are completed.
requirements.productionEntryPoint: Current Python application until all parity, packaging, native workflow/device and rollback gates pass.

implementation.linuxToolkit: Rust GTK3 0.18.2 bindings with Wry 0.57.0 / WebKitGTK 4.1 API
implementation.nativeOwnedIdentity: Main-window owner and editor/terminal identities are captured natively; typed renderer reports cannot supply owner or filesystem/process/device authority.
implementation.islands: Separate offline Monaco editor and xterm terminal webviews; no HTML application toolbar.
implementation.compileFixture: Native callback only; no firmware compilation or hardware operation is enabled.

localVerification.pythonApplicationServiceCheckScope: Native host /proc/self/maps contains no libpython; this does not qualify the remaining application backend.

reviewRegressions.workerHost: Native diff-worker readiness initially failed because the retained bundle replaces MonacoEnvironment; install the bounded worker host after bundle initialization. Original assets unchanged.
reviewRegressions.processCleanup: Exited session leaders initially left ordinary and SIGTERM-ignoring children alive. Retain an unreaped direct child via waitid(WNOWAIT) through captured group TERM/KILL cleanup; refuse externally reaped identities and leave unrelated sessions untouched. Not containment of descendants deliberately leaving that session/group.
reviewRegressions.pathBoundary: Selected scratch-root and output-leaf symlinks and hardlink write-through were reproduced in owned canaries. Controller now holds no-follow directory handles and atomically replaces regular output leaves; Rust rejects selected scratch ancestors outside/aliased from the checkout.

ciConfigured.qualification: See actual job conclusions at their exact checkpoint; no physical desktop or release qualification.

remainingGates: Actual Windows10/11 desktops and native Ubuntu Wayland/input/mixed-monitor qualification; hosted Win32 and Linux X11 fixtures already pass.
Actual keyboard/focus/IME/clipboard/accessibility, source tabs, resize, DPI and mixed-monitor detach/recovery.
Complete Rust settings, source-save/ownership/recovery, discovery, package/setup, build/upload/serial/PTY, cloud/vault and lifecycle backend parity.
Full notices, launchers/packages, upgrade/rollback and supported desktop/device/USB/performance qualification.

windowsAdapterFollowup.nativeWidgets: Win32 window, combo, buttons, labels, splitter and owned editor/terminal hosts; Wry/WebView2 child views
windowsAdapterFollowup.owner: Stable UI-thread Events allocation; views/contexts drop before HWND trees; callbacks cannot retain App references or renderer-supplied owner authority
windowsAdapterFollowup.crossTargetCheck: Strict all-target MSVC Clippy passes on Linux; not runtime proof
